title: Napoleon Lost a Battle to Rabbits 🐰 #shorts
description:
In 1807, to celebrate the peace of Tilsit, Napoleon's chief of staff Berthier laid on a rabbit hunt. But the rabbits had been bought tame from farmers, not caught wild, and when the cages opened they ran straight at the Emperor. Sticks and whips couldn't stop them; legend says they split into two wings, turned his flank, and chased him back to his carriage. The story comes from General Thiébault's memoirs, so take the details with a pinch of carrot.
